verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh is an AML and KYC onboarding compliance platform, and a buyer could fairly ask whether such a product offers document capture in verification flows, so the axis applies. However, the evidence covers only sanctions/PEP screening, case management, webhooks, the API and OpenAPI. It contains nothing on native iOS, Android or web SDKs, nor on guided camera capture with glare, blur or edge detection.
